summary: Examples use contains directly on a list and as a selectattr selector to find the LACP group whose interfaces include em1.
questions: How do I find the dict in a list whose sub-list contains a value?
How do I use contains inside selectattr?

answer_card.title: contains test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ listofthings is contains('this') }}

when: (lacp_groups | selectattr('interfaces', 'contains', 'em1') | first).master
```
The second picks the group whose `interfaces` list includes `em1`.
